notes: Frame it: “in 15 minutes we will do a miniature version of what we do in a real project”.
Name the five phases with one word each. Do not explain yet.
Ask them to keep their phone at hand: they take the link home at the end.
This is where you talk business models: classic franchise, master, licence, corners, dark kitchen, own branches.
The trick is back-casting: they write the ending and we draw the path from today.
Let the unexpected insight land on its own. Do not explain it right away.
Ask for one live correction: “what does the chicken really cost you?”. That moment is the demo.
Every generated number carries the est. tag. Never present it as fact.
Close with the idea: the structure is what scales, not the number.
The preselected pain connects with the hero item from Finance: keep the thread.
Agentic format: let the client talk to the manual. That is where the training platform sells itself.
Key line: “every standard has an indicator. If it cannot be measured, it is not a standard”.
Anatomy only: what each clause protects and for whom. No contract text.
Seneor Lawyers: more than 6,500 trademarks, including Totto, Sodexo and Mercado Libre.
If the trademark check is unavailable, say we review it in the session. Never invent results.
Reframe: this is not an audit. It is “if someone wanted to buy your franchise today, would they find you?”.
The listing already exists: it only needs activating. That is the soft commercial close.
Have them pick a favourite idea: it is saved into the report.
Walk the five take-homes in 20 seconds. They have already seen them.
Offer the two paths: Bootcamp Flash (15 days) or Consultoría 360. Book the next step right here.
Close with: “this was 1% of the project. You have seen the method”.
